name: Discombobulate
source:
Caleb wakes up in an unfamiliar place – an old, run-down apartment filled with the musty scent of time. Dazed and confused, he remembers only his name: Caleb. 

His memories are completely gone, and he has no idea how he ended up here. All he knows is that he must find a way to escape.
